text_block_list.text: One day, I came to the nurse's office to have <chrname>'s condition checked, and—

"Ah, yes, hello~! Custo... I mean,
student, right!"

Injuries? Illness? Or mental care?
Well, leave it aaall to me with a boom!

Huh? Well, she's in the infirmary, so...
A somewhat fantastic school nurse?
Or something like that?

Ahaha, guess you're not that easily fooled.
I'll just introduce myself normally after all.
Ahem! Truth be told, I am none other than—

The savior who guides (probably) countless Umamusume!
The (self-proclaimed) legendary acupuncturist with miraculous hands!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Its name is Sasami Anshinzawa!!
Wow, such re~lief☆

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: My, oh my~...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Wow, you don't look relieved at aaall☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"Alright, alright, that's enough of that for now.
Now that intros are out of the way, ready to get jabbed?"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, don't say you're sulking.
That's not very peaceful at all~.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! There's no need to be scared, you know?
I'm just going to poke a little pressure point with my secret bamboo needle.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
And then, wham... and bam...
Anyway, it's gonna be insaaanely incredible!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Just so you know, there's nothing shady about this!
I haven't failed even once, after all!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: ...And Master is?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Come on, this is my first job, so
broadly speaking, I've never failed before!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I spent ten whole years serving tea under a legendary master...
I mean, training under one, so I've got plenty of experience.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Wow, what a relieeef☆

I couldn't possibly agree to an offer like this.
Taking <chrname> with me,
I was about to walk out, but—

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: W-Wait, wait, wait, hold on!!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
You're Grass Wonder, aren't you?!
The Umamusume aiming for the top... with unshakeable resolve!!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Of course I know! I saw it!!
Because I'm a fan!!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I came here to cheer you guys on!
Believe it or not, I came to help out!!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
So pleeeaaase~~!!
Give me a chance, will ya~~?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Even if you say so...
We're in a bit of a bind, aren't we, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Please, please, please!
I'll even let you choose which pressure point to hit!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: There's no waaaay I'll mess up~!!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: ...Probably.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, well, more like practically almost definitely? Kind of?
...Whatever, don't worry about the details!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, which pressure point should we aim for?!
Stat boost, health boost...
Ooh, there's even a charm boost!!

...It carries a terrifyingly dangerous scent, but
there's a slight chance it might have an incredible effect... maybe.
What should we do...?
choice_data_list: Aim for the pressure point that turns her into a strong Umamusume.
Aim for the secret pressure point that will let you win the race.
I'll aim for the pressure point that restores health and vigor!
Aim for the secret pressure point that boosts your charm!
I'm feeling anxious, so I'll sit this one out.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see!
'The pressure point to become a strong Umamusume,' right!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'm gonna jab it in, okay? Ready?
...Are you reeeeeeeeeally sure about this?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Okey-doke, leave it to me!
Come forth, bamboo needles! Reveal thyself, pressure points!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Now, relax your muscles~... Wow, pain-free☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Time for a jab!!
Jab successfully administered!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, shall we head out to train?
...I feel a sudden urge to run a bit.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, it succeeded? Seriously!? Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
No waaaay!!
How did I even do that~?!?! I'm a genius~~~~!!

<chrname> was brimming with an unrecognizable,
incredible surge of power!

It seems she's seized her potential.
I felt that we had taken a huge step toward our dream...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... This in itself...
seems like it will be... good training.

out of sorts...

—Hey, you!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Gyahaa!? Crap, I got caught!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: ...Whoa, time to retreat~☆

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, they were quite delightful, weren't they?

text_block_list.text:
"...Solemn and sincere.
In a serious match, there is no room for tasteless behavior, is there?"

"Just who on earth was Sasabari...?
Thinking about it seemed pointless,
so I decided to forget about today's incident."

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, did you get it wrong?
Well, that totally happens, it happens all the time!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Well then, tell me one more time, please.
Which pressure point should we aim for!?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:

What on earth was that all about...?
I exchanged glances with <chrname>,
